name: biobb_vs GninaRun
title: Wrapper of the gnina software.
description: This class performs docking of a ligand to a receptor, optionally rescoring the poses with a convolutional neural network, via the gnina software.

input_ligand_path.description: Path to the input ligand. It may hold several ligands and it must hold genuine 3D coordinates, as gnina samples torsions but never bond lengths, bond angles or ring conformations

It only needs atoms with Cartesian coordinates, it does not need to be a real molecule. Mutually exclusive with input_box_path

file_formats.description: Path to the log file written by gnina

cpu.description: Number of CPU cores to use. Keep it lower than or equal to exhaustiveness, and always set it explicitly on a shared machine.

exhaustiveness.description: Number of independent Monte Carlo search chains. This is the main sampling knob, but it gives diminishing returns past the default for a targeted pocket.

num_modes.description: Maximum number of binding modes written out.

min_rmsd_filter.description: RMSD in Angstroms below which a pose is dropped as redundant with a better ranked one.

num_mc_saved.description: Number of top poses retained in each Monte Carlo chain, gnina defaults to 50 when unset.

seed.description: Explicit random seed. Docking is stochastic, so set it for reproducible runs.

scoring.description: Built-in empirical scoring function, gnina uses its own default when unset.

property_formats.name: default
property_formats.description: the gnina default empirical scoring function

property_formats.name: vinardo
property_formats.description: a reparameterization of the Vina terms that often does better for virtual screening

property_formats.name: dkoes_fast
property_formats.description: a fast variant of the dkoes scoring function

cnn_scoring.description: Where the convolutional neural network is used in the pipeline, gnina defaults to rescore when unset.

property_formats.name: none
property_formats.description: empirical scoring only throughout, by far the fastest

property_formats.name: rescore
property_formats.description: the network only re-ranks the final pool of poses

property_formats.name: refinement
property_formats.description: the network also locally minimizes poses after the Monte Carlo search, around ten times slower

property_formats.name: metrorescore
property_formats.description: network rescoring combined with Metropolis sampling

property_formats.name: metrorefine
property_formats.description: network refinement combined with Metropolis sampling

property_formats.name: all
property_formats.description: the network scores the whole search, very slow

cnn.description: Name of a built-in convolutional neural network model, or a name ending in _ensemble to evaluate every built-in model sharing that prefix. gnina defaults to an ensemble of three models when unset.

pose_sort_order.description: How the internal pose pool is sorted before the redundancy filter and the num_modes cutoff are applied, so it can surface a different set of poses and not merely reorder them. gnina defaults to CNNscore when unset.

property_formats.name: CNNscore
property_formats.description: sort by network pose score, which answers whether a pose is right

property_formats.name: CNNaffinity
property_formats.description: sort by predicted affinity, which is what ranks compounds in a screen

autobox_add.description: Buffer in Angstroms added on every side of the box derived from input_autobox_path, gnina defaults to 4 when unset. A larger box does not slow gnina down, but it does loosen the constraint on sampling.

autobox_extend.description: Enlarge the box derived from input_autobox_path when needed so the input ligand can rotate freely inside it, gnina enables this when unset.

minimize.description: Energy minimize the poses given in input_ligand_path instead of searching for new ones.

score_only.description: Score the poses given in input_ligand_path without searching or minimizing.

local_only.description: Restrict the search to a local one inside the box.

no_gpu.description: Disable GPU acceleration even when a GPU is available.

device.description: Index of the GPU device to use.

binary_path.description: Path to the gnina executable in your local computer. gnina is not distributed with this package, install it from its binary release or run it through a container.

restart.description: Do not execute if output files exist.

sandbox_path.description: Parent path to the sandbox directory.

container_shell_path.description: Path to default shell inside the container.
